infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SURAKSHA AI attaches your last known location to an emergency alert and lets you share live location with trusted contacts while an incident is active.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SURAKSHA AI attaches your last known location to an emergency alert and lets you share live location with trusted contacts while an incident is active.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is not used in this version.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SURAKSHA AI uses the microphone only when you tap the voice assistant, to transcribe a short safety request. Audio is sent once for transcription and is not stored.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: SURAKSHA AI uses your location to attach it to an emergency alert and share it with your trusted contacts.

plugins.microphonePermission: SURAKSHA AI uses the microphone only when you tap the voice assistant, to transcribe a short safety request.
